summary.en-US: Makes the Traumasoft employee schedule readable on a phone: a day-by-day agenda of your shifts, and a one-day-at-a-time view of the Vehicle/Location calendars with open-shift badges, filters, a person search and a per-person month calendar.

description.en-US:
The Traumasoft schedule page is a desktop month grid that runs off the edge of a phone screen. This add-on restyles it, on phones only, without changing how the site works.

Individual Month View becomes a vertical agenda: one row per day, your shifts as cards with unit, time and details, today marked, past days muted, and a Today button. Each card also shows who is on the unit with you for those hours, or that the other seat is open; for an open seat, "See spares" lists everyone else working those hours that day without a partner, with their unit and hours. This information comes from the site's own BLS (and, if needed, ALS and Details) views for the month, which the add-on loads in the background the way the View dropdown does.

A Schedule / More Options switch keeps the calendar first and tucks the status figures and the substitution, trade, time-off and pickup links behind the second tab.

Vehicle/Location Month Views (for example BLS) show one day at a time under a sticky pager: a strip of day chips with the number of requestable open shifts on each day, previous/next buttons, All / Open only / Mine filters, and a Find-a-person box that shows only the units that person is on, highlights their name, and marks which days of the month they work. A Calendar button turns that into a month grid with a dot per shift; tap a day to see each shift's unit, hours, and who they are working with or whether the other seat is open.

The header becomes a quick bar: calendar (schedule), wrench (the maintenance work order forms), checklist (BLS and ALS checklists) and clock (punch clock), with the notifications reachable from an Alerts entry in the menu. The work order forms, the Fleet maintenance request and the checklists are restyled into a single column with full-width controls, and the checklist odometer accepts any reading at or above the last one, with or without decimals. On the punch clock page, one large Punch In or Punch Out button replaces the two images, the clock and your shift list stay, and punching more than 7 minutes before your shift starts or ends asks you first, because the site otherwise demands a reason with no way back.

On the login page, the username you last signed in with is filled in for you (the password is never stored), and the fields are tagged so Firefox's own password manager can recognise the form.

Open shifts you can request are the site's own buttons, just restyled, so tapping one opens the normal confirmation dialog, which is also sized to the phone.

No data is collected or sent anywhere other than those page requests to the site itself. The add-on only runs on traumasoft.com schedule pages and does nothing on desktop-sized screens. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with Traumasoft.

release_notes.en-US: Schedule page split into Schedule and More Options tabs. Quick bar in the header (schedule, work orders, checklists, punch clock); work order forms and BLS/ALS checklists restyled for phones; odometer accepts any reading above the last. Header Punch button and a one-button punch clock page that asks before an early punch. Login page: the username you last signed in with is filled in. Individual Month View: each shift shows who is on the unit with you or that the seat is open, with a See spares list of others working those hours without a partner. Calendar button beside Find a person: a month grid of that person's shifts; tap a day for unit, hours and crewmates. View picker split into Common and Other; changing the view, month or year reloads immediately.
